title: Finite coproduct lifting of componentwise surjections
statement: For finite J, componentwise surjectivity of maps Hom(U, X (a j)) → Hom(U, Y (a j)) implies surjectivity of Hom(U, ∐ fun j ↦ X (a j)) → Hom(U, ∐ fun j ↦ Y (a j)) induced by the coproduct map.

proof.text: Identify a finite coproduct with a biproduct, lift each component, and reassemble the lifts using biproduct.lift and biproduct.map.

theorem derived_finite_coproduct_surjective
    {A : Type u} [Category.{v} A] [Abelian A]
    [IsGrothendieckAbelian.{v} A] [HasDerivedCategory.{v} A]
    (I : Type v) (X Y : I → DerivedCategory A) (f : ∀ i, X i ⟶ Y i)
    (J : Type v) [Finite J] (a : J → I) (U : DerivedCategory A)
    (hf : ∀ j, Function.Surjective
      (fun g : U ⟶ X (a j) ↦ g ≫ f (a j))) :
    Function.Surjective
      (fun g : U ⟶ ∐ fun j ↦ X (a j) ↦
        g ≫ Limits.Sigma.map (fun j ↦ f (a j)))
